title: WP_REST_API_Index
description: The REST API index, which describes the site and the routes available on its REST API.

gmt_offset.description: The offset in hours from UTC of the site's timezone.

timezone_string.description: The site's timezone as a timezone identifier, such as `Europe/London`. An empty string if the site uses a manual UTC offset.

page_for_posts.description: The ID of the page that displays the latest posts, or `0` if there isn't one.

page_on_front.description: The ID of the page that displays on the front page, or `0` if there isn't one.

show_on_front.description: What to show on the front page.

namespaces.description: The namespaces registered on the REST API.

authentication.description: The supported authentication schemes, keyed by name.

application-passwords.description: The application passwords authentication scheme. Only present when application passwords are available.

authorization.description: The URL of the screen where a user can authorize an application.

routes.description: The routes available on the REST API, keyed by route pattern.

image_sizes.description: The registered image sizes, keyed by name. Only present when client-side media processing is enabled and the user can upload files.

crop.description: Whether to crop the image, or an array of the x and y crop positions.

image_size_threshold.description: The maximum width or height in pixels of an uploaded image before it's scaled down. Only present when client-side media processing is enabled and the user can upload files.

image_strip_meta.description: Whether to strip metadata from generated images. Only present when client-side media processing is enabled and the user can upload files.

image_max_bit_depth.description: The maximum bit depth of generated images. Only present when client-side media processing is enabled and the user can upload files.

generate_animated_image_subsizes.description: Whether to preserve animation in image sub-sizes. Only present when client-side media processing is enabled and the user can upload files.

site_logo.description: The attachment ID of the site logo, or `0` if there isn't one.

site_icon.description: The attachment ID of the site icon, or `0` if there isn't one.

site_icon_url.description: The URL of the site icon, or an empty string if there isn't one.

_embedded.description: The embedded representation of relations. Only present when the '_embed' query parameter is set.

wp:featuredmedia.description: The site logo and site icon attachments.
